profile.headline: Full Stack Developer
profile.summary: An accomplished IT professional focused on .NET full stack development who enjoys the opportunity to learn, improve skill set, provide leadership, and who delivers complex solutions as an individual or as an integral part of a team.

positions.title: Software Developer Team Lead
positions.description:
- Quality-assure the work of the entire team by helping manage Work Plans and monitor Standard Work documents in an agile environment. 
- Create and manage policies, procedures, and documentation.
- Break down projects into components, assign work to team members, track progress of work/projects, and update related Scrum documentation. 
- Design, develop, and maintain web, desktop, & mobile business application, web services, and automated jobs primarily using .NET technologies (VB & C#), Entity Framework, and MVC against SQL Server databases.
- Build and manage Web and Database servers hosted on Microsoft Azure for development and production environments.
- Develop and maintain API and custom integration’s between different systems such as inventory management, maintenance, CRM, and ERP systems to help share data and processes.
- Integrate RFID readers and mobile handhelds into InfoChip software.
- Assist in debugging, staging, testing, and deploying of native client applications, web based applications and services. 
- Design, develop, and maintain custom reports using SQL Server Reporting Services.
- Create, migrate, maintain, and administer SQL Server Databases.

positions.title: Programmer Analyst (I, III, IV)
positions.description:
- Analyze, design, develop, implement, and support applications utilizing PHP, JavaScript, HTML, Smarty, CSS, and PLSQL against data stored in Oracle, Mimer, and MySQL databases.
- Works closely with clients and co-workers to ensure they have the tools to be efficient and successful.
- Actively seeks to improve existing applications to help improve University efficiency and overall system satisfaction.
- Assists in the implementation and integration as well as support various third-party applications that include online surveys, building security/access control system, and automation job scheduler.
- Develop interfaces to ensure that data is properly synced between third-party applications, home-grown applications, and Ellucian ERP system of records.
- Provides off hour application support on a rotating basis.
- Evaluates bugs; resolves problems; utilizes Tortoise SVN.

positions.title: Student Programmer
positions.description: Create and maintain in-house ERP system on web based architecture using PHP, HTML, Smarty, and JavaScript.
